description: This file defines a static class 'HttpBackgroundJob' that manages execution of background jobs after HTTP requests, including tracking active jobs, handling HTTP context, and reloading shell contexts within the OrchardCore framework.

classes.name: HttpBackgroundJob
classes.description: A static class providing methods to execute background jobs after HTTP request completion within OrchardCore.

methods.name: ExecuteAfterEndOfRequestAsync
methods.description: Executes a background job in an isolated ShellScope after the current HTTP request ends, handling context reloading and user state.
